description: Implementation of WorkerThread class managing a worker thread, task queue, and synchronization mechanisms within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread for executing queued tasks, with start, stop, and synchronization capabilities.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of WorkerThread.

methods.name: createWorkerThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WorkerThread instance, with exception handling.

methods.name: WorkerThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts the worker thread.

methods.name: ~WorkerThread
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if still running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the worker thread to stop processing tasks.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the worker thread, waiting for its completion.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the task queue and notifies the worker thread.

methods.name: taskHandler
methods.description: Main loop executed by the worker thread to process tasks from the queue.

methods.name: waitForTask
methods.description: Waits for and retrieves the next task from the queue.
